info.title: API.SH: Figshare
info.description: The Figshare API from API.SH: public Figshare data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

One Figshare item (dataset, figure, paper, code...) with title, DOI, description (text and HTML), authors with ORCID, tags, categories, license, references, related materials, funding, citation, custom fields, embargo status, the list of its files (name, size, MD5, link) and its total views, downloads, shares and citations.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/figshare-article

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Figshare item id, a `10.6084/m9.figshare.<id>[.v<n>]` DOI or a figshare.com/articles/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Figshare's public research outputs (datasets, figures, papers, code, posters, theses, media, preprints) by words, title, author, tag, category, item type, institution, group and dates, sorted by relevance, date, views, downloads, shares or citations. Each result has id, title, DOI, type, dates, thumbnail and links; /figshare/v1/article has the full record. Searches page through the first 5,000 results. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/figshare-search

parameters.description: Item type: figure, media, dataset, poster, journal_contribution, presentation, thesis, code, online_resource, preprint, book, conference_contribution.

parameters.name: resource_doi
parameters.description: DOI of the paper the items belong to.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Usage of a Figshare item, collection or project: total views, downloads, shares and citations, a timeline by day, month or year for one counter, and optionally the totals by country (with cities).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/figshare-stats

parameters.name: counter
parameters.description: Counter for the timeline and country totals.

parameters.name: by_country
parameters.description: true adds totals by country and city.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Figshare categories, licenses and item types
get.description:
Figshare's category tree (with parent and path), licenses and item types, optionally filtered by words. Use category names and item types as search filters. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/figshare-vocabulary

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
